senses.gloss: f. (προθεσμία, sub. ἡμέρα) appointed day, fixed term. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1 הגיעה פ׳ שלכם וכ׳ (not פירותזי׳) your time for the return to Egypt has come; Yalk. Ex. 230 פרטגמ׳ (corr. acc.). Pesik. Baḥod., p. 103ᵇ sq. למלך שקידש … וקבע לה פ׳ וכיון שהגיעה פ׳ וכ׳ (not פרוזתימייא) like a king who betrothed a lady to himself and appointed for her a term (when to marry her), and when the time came, he said &c. (v. פְּרוֹטוֹגַמְיָא).
